notes:
Summary: Axiomium is building an internal code-search product for enterprise customers. Primary constraint = massive embedding corpus (40–80M vectors initially) with frequent re-indexing (daily to hourly deltas). They need reranking on top of ANN for precision. Latency target: 95th <40ms, 99th <80ms for single-query (topK=10) on typical dev queries. Throughput: bursty (CI/time-of-day) ~500 qps peak for search endpoints. Cost sensitivity: high — unit cost per query must be justified vs running their own vector infra.

Quotes / call snippets: "We can't accept 2–3s tail latency during peak builds" — Eng lead. "We need full SSO + provisioning sync; vendor must support SAML SP initiated flow and JIT user creation." — Security.

Technical requirements & preferences (from discovery):
- Index size target: 40M vectors day 1, plan to grow to 150M over 18 months.
- Frequent re-indexing: nightly full + continuous delta ingestion (ideally near-real-time for PRs).
- Reranking: must support transformer-based cross-encoder reranker after ANN recall. Reranker model candidate list: bi-encoder for recall (embedding model), then cross-encoder (reranker) on top.
- Model preferences: open LMs for rerank (distilled cross-encoders), quantization friendly, option to bring own models.
- Routing/fallback: prefer primary on dedicated cluster in us-west, fallback to private region cluster; warm KV cache for hot repos.
- Observability: token-level cost + per-route latency breakdown, traceability to commit IDs for model regression tests.

Security/Compliance notes:
- Must integrate with Axiomium IdP (Okta) via SAML; need SP metadata exchange and test IdP tenant for POC.
- Data residency: initial hosting in US-only; later EU region for enterprise customers.
- Audit logs retention: 1 year required; preference to offload to their SIEM (Splunk).

POC plan (agreed):
1) Week 0: exchange SAML metadata, provide POC onboarding playbook, share ingestion API and sample repo mapping.
2) Week 1: Redwood ingest 10M embeddings (sample), run baseline ANN recall + naive rerank; measure recall@10, p95/p99 latency.
3) Week 2: Tune batching/cache params; test delta ingestion path (hourly); run cost projection for 40M corpus.
4) Week 3-4: Stress test peak qps, validate failover to private region, deliver reranker quality evals vs baseline.

Open questions / risks:
- SAML metadata format differences — SecOps requested test tenant by Redwood; currently blocking SSO verification.
- Budget sign-off tied to legal review of encryption at rest key-handling — CISO requested KMS diagram.
- Reindex cadence: Axiomium may require sub-hour consistency for critical repos; need to validate ingestion pipeline SLA.
